text: The login form loses the email after a failed try. Fix it and open a PR. See #12 for the old report.
Looking at the login form now. I start with the state hook.

## Cause

`resetFields()` runs on **every** failed submit, so the email goes too.

## Fix

```ts
if (result.error) {
  setPassword("");
  return;
}
```

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `src/auth/useLoginForm.ts` | keep the email on error |
| `src/auth/LoginForm.test.tsx` | new test |

This also closes issue #9.
Done: docs for the login form are updated in #15.
Thanks. Now add a test for the remember-me box.
This is the box I mean.

## Remember-me test

The test checks that the box keeps its value after a failed try. I changed 3 files:

| File | Change | Lines |
|---|---|---:|
| `src/auth/LoginForm.tsx` | keep `remember` in state | 4 |
| `src/auth/LoginForm.test.tsx` | new test | 28 |
| `src/auth/useLoginForm.ts` | reset only the password | 2 |

### The test

```tsx
it("keeps the remember-me box after a failed try", async () => {
  render(<LoginForm onSubmit={failOnce} />);
  await user.click(screen.getByLabelText("Remember me"));
  await user.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Sign in" }));
  expect(screen.getByLabelText("Remember me")).toBeChecked();
});
```

### Steps

1. Run `pnpm test auth` once more.
2. Push the branch and update PR #14.

- [x] Email stays after a failed try
- [x] Remember-me box stays
- [ ] Check the screen reader label

Run it with:

```sh
pnpm test auth --watch=false
```
